armyRules.name: Combat Doctrines
armyRules.description:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

ASSAULT DOCTRINE
When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

DEVASTATOR DOCTRINE
This unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

TACTICAL DOCTRINE
When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.

Unless otherwise stated:
  • You can only select each combat doctrine once per battle.
  • Only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

armyRules.name: Transhuman Strategist
armyRules.description: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

armyRules.name: Librarius
armyRules.description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name.

In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit's psyker level.

Example: In a battle round, a psyker level 3 PSYKER unit could use three psychic level 1 abilities, or one psychic level 1 ability and one psychic level 2 ability, or one psychic level 3 ability.

abilities.name: Codex Discipline
abilities.description: You can select one combat doctrine one additional time per battle.

abilities.name: Assault Mastery
abilities.description: You can select the assault doctrine one additional time per battle.

abilities.name: Tactical Mastery
abilities.description: You can select the tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.

abilities.name: Devastator Mastery
abilities.description: You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.

abilities.name: Death Blow
abilities.description: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR units have +1 to charge rolls.

abilities.name: Wrath of the Chapter
abilities.description: Friendly TACTICUS units can re-roll advance rolls.

abilities.name: Codex Fire-Patterns
abilities.description: Friendly TACTICUS units' [RAPID FIRE] attacks benefit from [RAPID FIRE] when targeting units up to that attack's maximum range.

abilities.name: Shadow Masters
abilities.description:
When a friendly PHOBOS or SCOUT SQUAD unit has shot:
  • Those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden.
  • Or: That unit can make a normal move of up to D6". That unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

abilities.name: Vanguard Ambushers
abilities.description: At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly PHOBOS unit is hidden, that unit's attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

abilities.name: Walking Fortress
abilities.description:
In a turn a friendly GRAVIS unit made a normal move, that unit's ranged attacks:
  • Do not have [HEAVY].
  • Have +1 to hit rolls.

abilities.name: Indomitable Defence
abilities.description: While a friendly GRAVIS unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit's T have -1 to wound rolls.

abilities.name: Lightning-fast Strike
abilities.description: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER units have +2" M.

abilities.name: Enduring Vengeance
abilities.description: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT units can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

abilities.name: Combined Deployment
abilities.description:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is assailed until the end of the turn:
  • While a unit is assailed, when an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

abilities.name: Ironstorm Auto-Targeters
abilities.description:
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE units' (excluding WALKER units) ranged attacks can:
  • Re-roll one hit roll.
  • Re-roll one wound roll.

abilities.name: Armoured Wrath
abilities.description: Each time a friendly unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for that unit. If your army includes CAANOK VAR or IRON FATHER FEIRROS, each of those models has a 6" aura: while a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within range of one or more of those models, each time that unit is selected to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll AND one Damage roll made for that unit (instead of just one of the three).

abilities.name: Mastered Doctrines
abilities.description: If your army includes a MARNEUS CALGAR model, each time you would select a Combat Doctrine, you can select it twice instead of once (subject to the normal once-per-doctrine-per-battle-round restrictions). Requires MARNEUS CALGAR.

abilities.name: Masters of Shadow
abilities.description: All friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units have the Stealth ability. All friendly PHOBOS and SCOUT SQUAD units have -3" Detection Range. If your army includes AETHON SHAAN, friendly AETHON SHAAN units have the following ability — Unparalleled Tactician (Once per battle round, once per army): When you use the Into Darkness stratagem, that use costs 1CP less (to a minimum of 0CP).

abilities.name: Vulkan's Quest
abilities.description: You can select the Devastator Doctrine an additional time per battle (subject to the normal once-per-battle-round restriction). Each time a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within 12", add 1 to that attack's Strength characteristic. If your army includes VULKAN HE'STAN, friendly INFERNUS SQUAD units can Advance or Fall Back and still perform an Action that phase, and if an INFERNUS SQUAD unit performs an Action, it can still be selected to shoot in that phase.

abilities.name: Adaptive Defence
abilities.description: While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within a terrain feature, re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for that unit's attacks. A friendly unit is Entrenched while it is within a terrain feature and it was not set up on the battlefield this phase and has not moved more than 3" this phase. If your army includes DARNATH LYSANDER or TOR GARADON, that model's unit is treated as being Entrenched at all times, regardless of the above conditions.

abilities.name: Storm-Swift Onslaught
abilities.description: You can select the Assault Doctrine or the Tactical Doctrine an additional time per battle (subject to the normal once-per-battle-round restriction). Add 1 to Advance rolls for friendly MOUNTED and SPEEDER units. If your army includes a SUBODEN KHAN unit, that unit gains the following ability — Wrath of the First Khan: If this unit is Engaged at the end of the Fight phase, it can make a Fall Back move; otherwise, it can make a Normal move.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.type: Gladius Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: A WORTHY DEATH
stratagems.type: Gladius Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:
  • On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: MIGHT OF ANGELS
stratagems.type: Gladius Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks have [LANCE].

stratagems.name: ADAPTIVE STRATEGY
stratagems.type: Gladius Task Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: STORM OF DEVASTATION
stratagems.type: Gladius Task Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: RESPONSIVE TACTICS
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.phase: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: GENE-WROUGHT MIGHT
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks have:
  • [LANCE].
  • Or: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, [LANCE] and +1 AP.

stratagems.name: DUTY IN DEATH
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if the assault doctrine is active for your unit:
  • On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.phase: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: DOMINATION FIRE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has shot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn:
  • While a unit is suppressed, that unit's attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: MASTERFUL TACTICS
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
  • Up to D6".
  • Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.phase: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: STORM OF FIRE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks have:
  • [IGNORES COVER].
  • Or: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, [IGNORES COVER] and +1 AP.

stratagems.name: HAIL OF VENGEANCE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if those attacks destroyed a model in a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL DREADNOUGHT FORTITUDE
stratagems.type: Terminator Storm Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: MERCILESS VETERANS
stratagems.type: Terminator Storm Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks have:
  • [LETHAL HITS].
  • [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: GUNSHIP EXTRACTION
stratagems.type: Terminator Storm Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.phase: End of your opponent’s Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagems.type: Tacticus Attack Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's attacks have:
  • [SUSTAINED HITS 1: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].
  • Or: [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

stratagems.name: TRANSHUMAN SWIFTNESS
stratagems.type: Tacticus Attack Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.

TARGET: One friendly TACTICUS unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.

EFFECT: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL FOCUS
stratagems.type: Tacticus Attack Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to make a consolidation move.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: When making that consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: FOR THE EMPEROR!
stratagems.type: Tacticus Firestorm Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly TACTICUS unit that is within range of an objective.

EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagems.type: Tacticus Firestorm Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's attacks have:
  • [SUSTAINED HITS 1: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE].
  • Or: [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

stratagems.name: POINT-BLANK BRUTALITY
stratagems.type: Tacticus Firestorm Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged TACTICUS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That TACTICUS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks (excluding [BLAST] attacks) have:
  • [CLOSE-QUARTERS].
  • [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
stratagems.type: Phobos Shadow Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's attacks have:
  • +1 S.
  • [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: MORTIS SNARES
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: If your unit is controlling an objective, that objective is snared. While an objective is snared, when an enemy unit ends a move within range of that objective, roll one D6:
  • On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.
  • That objective is no longer snared.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
stratagems.type: Phobos Shadow Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.phase: End of your opponent’s Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
stratagems.type: Phobos Shock Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's attacks have:
  • +1 S.
  • [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: TRANSHUMAN REACTIONS
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged PHOBOS unit.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
  • Up to D6".
  • Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

stratagems.name: UMBRAL EVASION
stratagems.type: Phobos Shock Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PHOBOS unit.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
stratagems.type: Gravis Linebreaker Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: PURGATION PUSH
stratagems.type: Gravis Linebreaker Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT:
  • If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move of up to 5", and must end that move within range of an objective.
  • Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: ARMOURED IMPACT
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: When your unit ends a charge move, you can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
  • For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
stratagems.type: Gravis Siege Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: STAND UNYIELDING
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: SUPPRESSION VOLLEYS
stratagems.type: Gravis Siege Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: WIND-SWIFT EVASION
stratagems.type: Stormlance Task Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit that was eligible to fight this phase.

EFFECT:
  • If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move.
  • Or: If your unit is engaged, your unit can make a fall-back move.

stratagems.name: SUDDEN ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit is selected to make an advance move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can change its advance rolls to a 6.

stratagems.name: HURTLING TARGETS
stratagems.type: Stormlance Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: ADAMANTINE TERROR
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: MERCY IS WEAKNESS
stratagems.phase: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's attacks have:
  • [LETHAL HITS].
  • Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: UNSTOPPABLE ADVANCE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: AGGRESSIVE DISEMBARKATION
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within a TRANSPORT is selected to move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: While making that move, each model in your unit can be set up within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

This allows you to set up your unit within the set-up distance of your TRANSPORT, instead of wholly within that distance.

stratagems.name: DUTY IS NEVER DONE
stratagems.type: Gauntlet Task Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase, is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit, and is eligible to embark within that TRANSPORT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

stratagems.name: STORM AND SECURE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit that has an ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit embarked within it.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: LAYERED CERAMITE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: MIGHT OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER units).

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit's:
  • M.
  • BS.
  • Hit rolls and wound rolls.

stratagems.name: HEADHUNTER DOCTRINE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER units) is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

stratagems.name: ANCIENT FURY
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One friendly DREADNOUGHT unit. EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to that unit's Move, Toughness, Leadership and Objective Control characteristics, and add 1 to Hit rolls for attacks made by that unit.

stratagems.name: SPIRITS OF IRON
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly unit. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, that unit has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: MERCY IS WEAKNESS
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly unit that has been selected to shoot or fight. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, that unit's attacks have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability; if that unit is a VEHICLE, also add 1 to Wound rolls for its attacks.

stratagems.name: UNBOWED CONVICTION
stratagems.description: TARGET: One friendly unit that is below its Starting Strength. EFFECT: Until the end of the round, that unit's models can ignore any or all modifiers to their Ballistic Skill and Weapon Skill characteristics, and to Hit rolls and Wound rolls made for them.

stratagems.name: POWER OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after a VEHICLE unit from your army has been targeted by one or more enemy attacks. TARGET: That VEHICLE unit, if it was not destroyed. EFFECT: That unit can be selected to shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, firing as if making an Overwatch attack; if it is at or below Half-strength, it fires normally instead.

stratagems.name: VENGEFUL ANIMUS
stratagems.description: WHEN: A friendly VEHICLE unit is destroyed. EFFECT: That unit's Deadly Demise ability is automatically triggered (treat the test as passed, at maximum effect where applicable).

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.type: Blade of Ultramar – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.phase: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly unit. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: PRACTICAL TACTICS

abilities.name: Feel No Pain 5+
abilities.description:
FEEL NO PAIN
Some models have ‘Feel No Pain x+’ listed in their abilities. Each time a model with this ability suffers damage and so would lose a wound (including wounds lost due to mortal wounds), roll one D6: if the result is greater than or equal to the number denoted by ‘x’, that wound is ignored and is not lost. If a model has more than one Feel No Pain ability, you can only use one of those abilities each time that model suffers damage and so would lose a wound.

  • Feel No Pain x+: Each time this model would lose a wound, roll one D6: if the result equals or exceeds ‘x’, that wound is not lost.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
LEADER
Some CHARACTER units have ‘Leader’ listed on their datasheets. Such CHARACTER units are known as Leaders, and the units they can lead – known as their Bodyguard units – are listed on their datasheet.

During the Declare Battle Formations step, for each Leader in your army, if your army also includes one or more of that Leader’s Bodyguard units, you can select one of those Bodyguard units. That Leader will then attach to that Bodyguard unit for the duration of the battle and is said to be leading that unit. Each Bodyguard unit can only have one Leader attached to it.

While a Bodyguard unit contains a Leader, it is known as an Attached unit and, with the exception of rules that are triggered when units are destroyed, it is treated as a single unit for all rules purposes. Each time an attack targets an Attached unit, until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, you must use the Toughness characteristic of the Bodyguard models in that unit, even if a Leader in that unit has a different Toughness characteristic. Each time an attack sucessfully wounds an Attached unit, that attack cannot be allocated to a CHARACTER model in that unit, even if that CHARACTER model has lost one or more wounds or has already had attacks allocated to it this phase. As soon as the last Bodyguard model in an Attached unit has been destroyed, any attacks made against that unit that have yet to be allocated can then be allocated to CHARACTER models in that unit.

Each time the last model in a Bodyguard unit is destroyed, each CHARACTER unit that is part of that Attached unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time the last model in a CHARACTER unit that is attached to a Bodyguard unit is destroyed and there is not another CHARACTER unit attached, that Attached unit’s Bodyguard unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time a unit that is part of an Attached unit is destroyed, it does not have the keywords of any other units that make up that Attached unit (unless it has those keywords on its own datasheet) for the purposes of any rules that would be triggered when that unit is destroyed.

Example: If you only destroy the Bodyguard unit that is part of an Attached unit, you have not destroyed a CHARACTER unit. If you only destroy the CHARACTER unit that is part of an Attached unit, or if you destroy the whole Attached unit, you have destroyed one CHARACTER unit.

  • Before the battle, CHARACTER units with the Leader ability can be attached to one of their Bodyguard units to form an Attached unit.
  • Attached units can only contain one Leader.
  • Attacks cannot be allocated to CHARACTER models in Attached units.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
LEADER
Some CHARACTER units have ‘Leader’ listed on their datasheets. Such CHARACTER units are known as Leaders, and the units they can lead – known as their Bodyguard units – are listed on their datasheet.

During the Declare Battle Formations step, for each Leader in your army, if your army also includes one or more of that Leader’s Bodyguard units, you can select one of those Bodyguard units. That Leader will then attach to that Bodyguard unit for the duration of the battle and is said to be leading that unit. Each Bodyguard unit can only have one Leader attached to it.

While a Bodyguard unit contains a Leader, it is known as an Attached unit and, with the exception of rules that are triggered when units are destroyed, it is treated as a single unit for all rules purposes. Each time an attack targets an Attached unit, until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, you must use the Toughness characteristic of the Bodyguard models in that unit, even if a Leader in that unit has a different Toughness characteristic. Each time an attack sucessfully wounds an Attached unit, that attack cannot be allocated to a CHARACTER model in that unit, even if that CHARACTER model has lost one or more wounds or has already had attacks allocated to it this phase. As soon as the last Bodyguard model in an Attached unit has been destroyed, any attacks made against that unit that have yet to be allocated can then be allocated to CHARACTER models in that unit.

Each time the last model in a Bodyguard unit is destroyed, each CHARACTER unit that is part of that Attached unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time the last model in a CHARACTER unit that is attached to a Bodyguard unit is destroyed and there is not another CHARACTER unit attached, that Attached unit’s Bodyguard unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time a unit that is part of an Attached unit is destroyed, it does not have the keywords of any other units that make up that Attached unit (unless it has those keywords on its own datasheet) for the purposes of any rules that would be triggered when that unit is destroyed.

Example: If you only destroy the Bodyguard unit that is part of an Attached unit, you have not destroyed a CHARACTER unit. If you only destroy the CHARACTER unit that is part of an Attached unit, or if you destroy the whole Attached unit, you have destroyed one CHARACTER unit.

  • Before the battle, CHARACTER units with the Leader ability can be attached to one of their Bodyguard units to form an Attached unit.
  • Attached units can only contain one Leader.
  • Attacks cannot be allocated to CHARACTER models in Attached units.

abilities.name: Deadly Demise D3
abilities.description:
DEADLY DEMISE
Some models have ‘Deadly Demise x’ listed in their abilities. When such a model is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it from play (if such a model is a TRANSPORT, roll before any embarked models disembark). On a 6, each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by ‘x’ (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").

Example: A TRANSPORT model with the Deadly Demise D3 ability is destroyed. Before any models disembark and before removing it from play, its controlling player rolls one D6, getting a 6. There are three units within 6" of that destroyed model, so its controlling player rolls one D3 for each of them, inflicting mortal wounds accordingly.

  • Deadly Demise x: When this model is destroyed, roll one D6. On a 6, each unit within 6" suffers ‘x’ mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Firing Deck 7
abilities.description:
FIRING DECK
Some TRANSPORT models have ‘Firing Deck x’ listed in their abilities. Each time such a model is selected to shoot in the Shooting phase, you can select up to ‘x’ models embarked within it whose units have not already shot this phase. Then, for each of those embarked models, you can select one ranged weapon that embarked model is equipped with (excluding weapons with the [ONE SHOT] ability). Until that TRANSPORT model has resolved all of its attacks, it counts as being equipped with all of the weapons you selected in this way, in addition to its other weapons. Until the end of the phase, those selected models’ units are not eligible to shoot.

  • Firing Deck ‘x’: Each time this TRANSPORT shoots, select one weapon (excluding weapons with the [ONE SHOT] ability) from up to ‘x’ models embarked within it whose units have not shot this phase; this TRANSPORT counts as being equipped with those weapons as well. Until the end of the phase, those selected models’ units are not eligible to shoot.

Some models have ‘Deadly Demise x’ listed in their abilities. When such a model is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it from play (if such a model is a TRANSPORT, roll before any embarked models disembark). On a 6, each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by ‘x’ (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").

There are three units within 6" of that destroyed model, so its controlling player rolls one D3 for each of them, inflicting mortal wounds accordingly.

abilities.name: Scouts 8"

SCOUTS
Some units have ‘Scouts x"’ listed in their abilities. A unit that moves using this ability must end that move more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy models. If both players have units that can do this, the player who is taking the first turn moves their units first.
